extDescription.message: Pause and resume web media in the most recently playing Chrome tab.

commandDescription.message: Pause or resume web media in the most recently playing tab

stateIdle.message: Play media to control it here.

errorPauseNothing.message: No media is playing in the latest tab.

errorResumeNothing.message: No previously played media is available to resume in the latest tab.

errorNoTarget.message: No media to control. Start playback once, then try again.

errorPageConnection.message: Could not reach the page. Try the shortcut again when the page responds.

errorResumeSome.message: Some media could not resume. Check the popup.

errorResumeNone.message: Could not find media to resume. Refresh the tab and try again.

shortcutHint.message: Global by default. Change the scope to Chrome if you prefer.

footer.message: Controls video and audio on HTTP and HTTPS pages.

errorAmbiguousTarget.message: Media is playing in multiple tabs. Start playback in the tab you want to control.

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: Could not copy diagnostics. Copy the text below.

errorResumeBlocked.message: The browser blocked playback. Start media on the site, then try again.

errorResumeTimeout.message: Playback did not start within six seconds. Try the shortcut again.

errorResumeAmbiguous.message: Several media items have the same playback order. Play the item you want on the site once, then try again.

commandVolumeUp.message: Volume up 10% in the most recently playing tab

commandVolumeDown.message: Volume down 10% in the most recently playing tab

commandSpeedUp.message: Speed up by 0.25× in the most recently playing tab

commandSpeedDown.message: Slow down by 0.25× in the most recently playing tab

commandSpeedReset.message: Reset speed to 1× in the most recently playing tab

levelMutedNote.message: Muted on the page. Volume changes do not unmute.

errorAdjustNothing.message: No media to adjust in the latest tab.

errorAdjustSome.message: Some media could not be adjusted.

errorTargetChanged.message: The latest media tab changed. Check the popup and try again.

shortcutsMoreHint.message: Volume and speed shortcuts can also be set on the same page.

boostHint.message: Applies a separate 0–500% multiplier to the site's own volume. Media you adjust uses the browser's audio processing until the page is reloaded.

boostLimitedNote.message: A source change may limit output for boosted media. Reload the page if you hear nothing.

boostOffNote.message: Extension volume is off and back to 100%. Media adjusted before keeps the audio path until the page is reloaded.

errorBoostRefused.message: Extension volume isn't available for this media. The volume was kept.

errorBoostResetUnreached.message: Extension volume is off, but resetting it could not be confirmed in $1 page frames. It will be retried when they respond; reloading those pages also removes it.

extVolumeHint.message: 100% keeps the site's own sound. If the site is at 0% or muted, the extension does not bring the sound back.

errorExtVolumeOff.message: Extension volume is off. Turn it on in the popup to change volume.
